# Content-addressed reuse, explicit links and manual retention run end to
# end on generic spaces over a persistent alias backend.
mkdir local
mkdir remote-files
exec sh -c 'printf "[nas]\ntype = alias\nremote = %s\n" "$1" > rclone.conf' sh $WORK/remote-files
chmod 0600 rclone.conf

exec sh -c 'printf "state: %s\nrclone_config: %s\n" "$1" "$2" > drivebridge.yaml' sh $WORK/state $WORK/rclone.conf

exec drivebridge space add --space nas --backend generic --remote nas --local-root $WORK/local --max-bytes 1048576
stdout 'Space configured'
exec drivebridge space add --space nas2 --backend generic --remote nas --local-root $WORK/local --max-bytes 1048576
stdout 'Space configured'

# A plain upload registers a stable reference.
exec sh -c 'printf "payload" > local/a.bin'
exec drivebridge upload --space nas --file a.bin --json
stdout '"status":"success"'
exec sh -c 'drivebridge upload --space nas --file a.bin --json | sed -n "s/.*\"file_ref\":\"\([^\"]*\)\".*/\1/p" > ref.txt'
exec sh -c 'test -s ref.txt'

# Re-uploading the same content under a new name either reuses the stored
# object server-side or falls back to a byte transfer: the alias backend has
# no server-side copy, so the honest fallback stores a second object.
exec sh -c 'cp local/a.bin local/b.bin'
exec drivebridge upload --space nas --file b.bin --name b.bin --json
stdout '"status":"success"'
exec sh -c 'ls remote-files | wc -l'
stdout '2'

# An explicit link registers a reference in the second space without copying.
exec sh -c 'drivebridge link --link-ref "$(cat ref.txt)" --space nas2 --name linked.bin --json'
stdout '"status":"success"'
exec sh -c 'drivebridge stat --ref "$(cat ref.txt)" --json'
stdout '"status":"success"'
exec sh -c 'ls remote-files | wc -l'
stdout '2'

# Retention: a TTL keeps scratch spaces collectable, pins protect references
# and gc is manual, dry-runnable and only ever trashes.
exec drivebridge space ttl --space nas --days 1 --json
stdout '"ttl_days":1'
exec drivebridge gc --space nas --dry-run --json
stdout '"dry_run":true'
stdout '"candidates":\[\]'
exec sh -c 'drivebridge pin --ref "$(cat ref.txt)" --json'
stdout '"pinned":true'
exec drivebridge gc --space nas --json
stdout '"collected":\[\]'
# Permanent spaces (the default) never collect.
exec drivebridge space ttl --space nas2 --days 0 --json
stdout '"ttl_days":0'
exec drivebridge gc --space nas2 --json
stdout '"ttl_days":0'
